name: Example: Modern Glass GUI
author: Golf Tycoon examples
description: A GUI theme mod (data only, no code): the whole interface - HUD, menus, panels, popups, fields and scrollbars - re-dressed as modern frosted glass. Translucent blue-slate panes, ice-white text, a mint-cyan accent and wide soft corners. One JSON palette styles everything; copy this folder to start your own design.
